summary: This standards-track RFC sets out the requirements and considerations for WebRTC applications that send and receive video. It specifies the video processing needed and which video codecs and parameters must be supported so browsers and other WebRTC endpoints can interoperate.

eli5.summary: When two apps make a video call, they must agree on a language for pictures. This lists the languages every app must understand so calls always work.

questions: which video codecs must webrtc support
